patch_description: Transitions the optimization scheme to a Direct Successive Over-Relaxation (SOR) Pointwise Solver (Gauss-Seidel). Rather than computing relative gradients for an Adam optimizer, this approach treats the path as an elastic band being acted upon directly by repulsion and attraction field forces. I implemented a 3000-sweep scheduler that smoothly shifts from a "carving phase" (high beta: school repulsion) to a "fine-tuning phase" (high gamma: base attraction). This elegantly leverages Gauss-Seidel stability to achieve smooth global deflections without exploding learning gradients, directly addressing the recommendation to minimize F3 without sacrificing the F2 clearance.
